verdict.rationale: Convex's pricing page lists Crons as a built-in feature on the Free and Starter plans, which covers recurring jobs. Its llms.txt describes a built-in scheduler for running background workflows, and the homepage lists workflow as a core primitive. The evidence is only feature-list mentions, though. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on cron definition and scheduling syntax, details on workflow durability and retries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
